verdict.rationale: The visual-scripting axis applies to a game engine, but the evidence never documents a node-based or visual scripting system for gameplay logic. Phaser Editor's drag-and-drop scene layout, Inspector filters, and the AI agent's plain-language prompts are adjacent features, not visual scripting. Gameplay logic is documented only as JavaScript or TypeScript code.

support.subject: As a technical artist, I can build gameplay logic with visual scripting without writing code
